seo.title: Eden Roc Miami Beach · Weddings, Mitzvahs & Celebrations
seo.description: Weddings, bar & bat mitzvahs and galas at Eden Roc Miami Beach: Morris Lapidus's oceanfront landmark, with ballrooms for up to 800 guests indoors and 1,500 outdoors. Music, lighting and production by Avinu Events.

hero.lead: Seventy years of Miami Beach glamour: oceanfront ceremonies, ballrooms where the stars of the 1950s performed, and room for up to 800 guests indoors.

paras: Designed by Morris Lapidus in the mid-1950s, Eden Roc was a stage for the stars of the era: its Mona Lisa Room once hosted Frank Sinatra, and the Pompeii Ballroom began life as a nightclub.
Today its ballrooms, gardens and oceanfront terraces host weddings and celebrations of every size, from dinners on the terrace to 1,500 guests on the lawn.

Service was excellent during our wedding night and also throughout the entire weekend…

production.text: Avinu Events produces the entertainment for celebrations across South Florida, from Miami Beach to Boca Raton: the music for the ceremony, the energy of the dance floor and the light that shapes the room.
